theorems.name: Submission.rsd_cmr_support_subset_of_vanish
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U K : Set (Euclid P)) (F : GeometricCurrentOn U n), IsOpen U → IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → (∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, Disjoint (tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n)) K → F ω = 0) → F.support ⊆ K ∧ IsCompact F.support
